name: Santa Beach Dash on Clearwater Beach
when_note: Half mile dash starts at noon, with a post race event at Pier 60
paras: The City of Clearwater lists the Santa Beach Dash for Sunday, December 20, 2026, starting at noon at Pier 60 on Clearwater Beach. The city says hundreds of Santas trade sleighs for sneakers for a festive half mile run, followed by a post race event at Pier 60 with live music and entertainment.

The Santa Beach Dash is part of Holidays in Lights, the season long celebration from AMPLIFY Clearwater that connects Downtown Clearwater and Clearwater Beach. The city lists registration at $25, and sign up runs through Eventbrite.
tip: Wear a Santa suit or your best festive outfit and register ahead through the city's link.
